loops-hourly-operations.name: Loops Overnight Gameplan
loops-hourly-operations.prompt:
Run the Ducketz post-close Gameplan workflow in C:\dev\ducketz as a standalone Scheduled task. Read docs\loops-system-analysis\NIGHTLY_GAMEPLAN.md completely first; it is the operating procedure for active supervision, repair, controlled stop, recovery, resume, and final verification. Inspect the current overnight status and existing Scheduled tasks before starting so there is only one owner. Start .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -u -m ml.overnight_runtime --datastore-target pc --once --scheduled --stock-only --independent-stock-horizons on an eligible completed session. This command fetches/appends the completed session, builds Directional data/models, evaluates all saved Gameplans from September 4, trains the four stock target groups and publishes the next session's independent-stock-targets-v1 Gameplan without waiting for optional Strategy training or generation. Stay with the running process and inspect status, new logs, and health history at least once a minute; do not end after launching it or wait until final completion to read errors. Investigate reported errors immediately. Healthy training may take hours and may continue over a weekend until 04:00 Pacific on the next exchange session. Do not mistake quiet CPU-active training for a stall. Make focused non-trading repairs backed by evidence and relevant tests, record the repair in operator-notes.md, and use the documented controlled stop/recovery and --resume-run procedure when a restart is necessary. Resume only the failed stage and retain the original deadline; do not blindly retry an unchanged failure. Preserve concurrent edits, raw data, immutable published Gameplans, model assessment gates, and all trading controls/code. Never place, cancel, or replace orders, run an old recurring stack, delete lock files, or start a second pipeline. Honor holiday no-op receipts. Verify the final report/receipt/logs, expected next-session date, exactly 24 forecasts and 24 intents per configured symbol (168 of each for seven symbols), cumulative evaluation coverage, provider coverage, model status, and zero overnight orders. Report exact unresolved failures, missing data, or research-only groups with evidence paths. Before starting, adopting, stopping, repairing, or resuming any work, generate one new UUID for this Scheduled task and acquire the supervision claim with python -m ml.overnight_runtime --datastore-target pc --claim-supervision <your-uuid>, using the repository .venv Python. Proceed only on ACQUIRED. Reuse your UUID to renew at least once a minute while monitoring or repairing; if BUSY, another task owns the run, so make no changes and end this wake. Never reuse another task's UUID. Release your claim with --release-supervision <your-uuid> when finished. The three-minute expiry lets the watch adopt an abandoned task without two operators repairing concurrently.

Symbol-universe integration: Read the production universe from C:\dev\ducketz\datafetching\watchlist.txt. New symbols use docs\loops-system-analysis\SYMBOL_ONBOARDING.md and become active only after verified onboarding. COST follows the same configured-universe contracts as the other symbols. Validate each immutable saved run against its own symbol manifest; older six-symbol Gameplans remain valid history. A current seven-symbol Gameplan has 168 forecasts and 168 options intents, with 21 production OPRA symbol/schema cursors.

The accepted stock-only design is documented in INDEPENDENT_STOCK_HORIZONS.md: 13 hourly entry forecasts, four forward four-hour forecasts including 16:00 through next exchange session 07:00, one extended 04:00�17:00 daily entry and one first-04:00 to fifth-session-17:00 weekly entry per symbol. The remaining five rows per symbol are explicitly non-entry research/outlooks. Keep the native five-minute price-observation tolerance, symbol-level fitted-history checks, chronological partitions, minimum sample counts and model promotion gates. Unsupported symbol/horizon histories remain RESEARCH_NO_TARGET_HISTORY. Options remain separate research; stock-only intents are NO_TRADE_STOCK_ONLY. Directional publication does not qualify the hourly-only enrichment model for these independent windows. Never relabel models or train/retry without new justified evidence.

loops-stock-trader-daily-adaptation.name: Loops Overnight Health Watch
loops-stock-trader-daily-adaptation.prompt:
Inspect Ducketz overnight work in C:\dev\ducketz as a standalone Scheduled health watch. Read docs\loops-system-analysis\NIGHTLY_GAMEPLAN.md, then run .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ml.overnight_runtime --datastore-target pc --status. Inspect the current stage report, recent stage log and health.jsonl, and existing Scheduled tasks. If a task already actively supervises or repairs this run, do not launch another owner or edit concurrently. A fresh heartbeat alone does not prove training progress: compare CPU/I/O/log progress and inspect reported errors. If the original task ended, adopt supervision, investigate failures as they appear, apply a focused evidence-backed non-trading repair with relevant tests, and use the documented controlled stop/recover/resume procedure. An exited supervisor needs --recover-run before --resume-run; creation-time checks must protect unrelated processes. Keep supervising an adopted or resumed run until completion or a concrete unresolved blocker. Preserve the original next-session 04:00 Pacific deadline and completed stages. Do not stop quiet CPU-active training or blindly retry unchanged failures. Record evidence and repairs in the run's operator-notes.md. When no unfinished registered symbol onboarding exists, for no run or an older completed run, start missing scheduled work only after 17:15 Pacific on an actual exchange-session date and only when no active Scheduled owner exists; use the normal --once --scheduled --stock-only --independent-stock-horizons command. Completed current-session work and holiday no-ops need no restart. On weekends or before the evening close, only supervise/resume an existing attempt whose deadline has not passed; never invent a new fetch or plan. Do not change trading code, controls, limits, model promotion gates, immutable Gameplans, raw data, or locks, and never place/cancel/replace orders or start the former recurring stack. Verify any repaired run's final receipt, new Gameplan, and evaluation coverage; report unresolved failures with evidence. Before starting, adopting, stopping, repairing, or resuming any work, generate one new UUID for this Scheduled task and acquire the supervision claim with python -m ml.overnight_runtime --datastore-target pc --claim-supervision <your-uuid>, using the repository .venv Python. Proceed only on ACQUIRED. Reuse your UUID to renew at least once a minute while monitoring or repairing; if BUSY, another task owns the run, so make no changes and end this wake. Never reuse another task's UUID. Release your claim with --release-supervision <your-uuid> when finished. The three-minute expiry lets the watch adopt an abandoned task without two operators repairing concurrently.

Symbol-universe integration: Read the production universe from C:\dev\ducketz\datafetching\watchlist.txt. New symbols use docs\loops-system-analysis\SYMBOL_ONBOARDING.md and become active only after verified onboarding. COST follows the same configured-universe contracts as the other symbols. Validate each immutable saved run against its own symbol manifest; older six-symbol Gameplans remain valid history. A current seven-symbol Gameplan has 168 forecasts and 168 options intents, with 21 production OPRA symbol/schema cursors.

Existing symbol onboarding: Also inspect C:\DATASTORE\state\symbol-onboarding\*.json. A registered plan without a verified activation receipt is an explicitly started maintenance attempt, including on weekends. After acquiring your own supervision claim, follow docs\loops-system-analysis\SYMBOL_ONBOARDING.md, including Health Watch continuation, and the registered plan's operator-notes.md. Supervise a living fetch or training process without duplicating it. Resume only the same authorized plan and candidate watchlist, preserving completed phases and any original overnight deadline. If its required OPRA session is unavailable, perform a read-only provider availability check and proceed only after the relevant boundary advances; unchanged provider lag is not a reason to restart acquisition or training. Complete verified acquisition, candidate Loops stages, stock model training, validation, activation, a non-submitting trader check, evaluation and measured storage documentation when prerequisites pass. Never activate a partial universe or relax data freshness or model promotion gates. Stay quiet while this state is unchanged; report completion, a material change or a concrete failure requiring attention.

Current stock scope: COST completed native activation on September 8. New stock publications use --stock-only --independent-stock-horizons, documented in INDEPENDENT_STOCK_HORIZONS.md. Resume scope is inherited from its verified stage report. Optional options training must not block this stock preparation. Preserve symbol-level missing-target-history statuses and all calibration/promotion gates. The daytime independent session worker has separate ownership and must not be started or altered by this overnight watch. An unchanged research-only direction model or unqualified enrichment model is not a reason to rerun training.

loops-stock-trader-live-shadow.name: Loops Gameplan Stock Trader � Independent Horizons
loops-stock-trader-live-shadow.prompt:
Run the configured seven-stock independent-horizon session from C:\dev\ducketz. Read docs\loops-system-analysis\INDEPENDENT_STOCK_HORIZONS.md first. Start exactly one native bounded session worker at this scheduled 03:59 Pacific wake:

.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -u -m ml.gameplan_stock_trader --datastore-target pc --execute --target-horizon all --run-session

The native worker covers the frozen 04:00�16:00 hourly entries, four-hour entries at 04:00/08:00/12:00/16:00, and the 04:00 daily and weekly entries. It manages separate horizon-owned shares, one active allocation per symbol/horizon, the agreed 1:2:3:4 allocation caps, and prescribed exits, including the 16:00 four-hour target through the next exchange session 07:00. Entries use their bounded grace; the worker handles the 13:05 broker transition and begins 17:00-close exits at 16:59. Fills are never guaranteed.

The verified current Gameplan, exact target contract, directional model promotion/edge, duration-qualified enrichment, both persistent stock controls, fresh account/quote evidence, stable account identity, reconciled fills, combined existing cash/exposure/order-size limits, six-order batch cap, and durable entry/order identities remain mandatory. Missing or unqualified inputs are a no-trade result. A worker with no owned inventory and unqualified enrichment exits immediately; report that reason and do not retry or launch the old trader. The September 8 preparation completed all four forecast fits but did not pass promotion, and the current enrichment remains hourly-only; do not change these statuses to force trades.

If the native worker remains active, supervise that one process through its bounded session and inspect its new output without launching a second owner. It exits at 17:00; report any residual horizon inventory or reconciliation problem. Never replay missed entries or repeat ambiguous submissions/cancellations. Never assign manual shares to a horizon or sell shares belonging to another horizon. Options remain research-only and no options order is authorized.

Do not edit code, model artifacts, Gameplans, pointers, controls or policy in this scheduled task. Preserve older immutable Gameplans and their own universe/target definitions. Read the production universe from datafetching\watchlist.txt; COST is activated and follows the same contracts as the other six. Report the worker result, selected/submitted stock orders, durable evidence paths and any fail-closed reason. The former hourly and 13:05 separate launches are replaced by this one native session worker.
